name: Subtitles
author: Lichtspiel
description: Downloads missing subtitles from OpenSubtitles for new movies and episodes and saves them in the server's data folder (subtitles), so the media folder may stay read-only; with next_to_video they go next to the video (Film.de.srt). Needs a free API key from opensubtitles.com/consumers; with your OpenSubtitles username and password you get more downloads a day.
